name: Combinatorial Parity Obfuscation
description: Replaces the quadratic equation with a combinatorial condition (the parity of the binomial coefficient C(tu+tv, tu)). Since C(2,1)=2, C(3,1)=3, C(3,2)=3, C(4,2)=6, requiring an odd number of combinations perfectly encodes tu != tv for tu,tv in {1,2}. This avoids algebraic patterns that models easily map to 2-coloring, forcing them to evaluate the combinatorial rule from scratch.
